title: Closeout summary: Sprint 5 - bwrk next and dogfood hardening
body:
Subject: sprint:bw_work_1f36933d37fc181d
Status: verified
Priority: normal

## Outcome

SPRINT BRIEF. Cash in the inversion: with every enforcement fact a gap and every gap a directive carrying an executable nextCommand, the agent loop can collapse to run bwrk next, do what it says, repeat. Scope: the bwrk next command that resolves the single highest-priority directive for the acting agent (blocking over required over advisory, then deterministic tie-break); a termination property test asserting that from reachable fixture states, repeatedly following next reaches work closure or an explicit human-escalation directive rather than looping; and an end-to-end dogfood run where an agent completes a fixture work order using only next output, plus the AGENT_DIRECTIVES.md rewrite documenting the final architecture. Done when the e2e run is recorded as evidence on this sprint and the docs describe the gap-projection design rather than the matcher.
